pages.text: The $(item)Blueprint Table$() remembers its 3x3 grid and has 18 storage slots. Ingredients are taken from storage first, so the grid works as a pattern. Shift-click the result to craft up to 64 times.

Put a $(item)Blank Plan$() in the left slot, lay out a recipe and press the pen button to save a $(item)Plan$(). A saved plan plus the button loads the recipe: empty grid slots are filled from storage.
